description: Benchmark task (docs/benchmark_rules.md). Preamplifier + regenerative-latch comparator of Sharma, Gupta, Shekhar (IEEE UPCON 2022, 'Design & Analysis of Performance-efficient Comparator for IoT Application'), gpdk180, 1.8 V, 1 GHz clock, alternating +/- differential inputs. Targets: the paper's propagation delay (clock edge to |V(X)-V(Y)| = VDD/2, Fig. 3) at the Table 3/4 grid (10 input common modes 0.8-1.7 V x 1/5/10 mV x tt/ff/ss corners at 1.8 V, 27 C), the Table 3 worst case (Vcm 0.6 V), Table 5 delay and power at 1.2 V and the 1.8 V power at Vid = 100 mV, the offset as the Monte Carlo sigma (3.8 mV), plus the functional requirements (every decision correct on OUT, X/Y reset). The paper reports no temperature (27 C used) and no load capacitance (5 fF on OUT used).

source.title: Design & Analysis of Performance-efficient Comparator for IoT Application (Sharma, Gupta, Shekhar; IEEE UPCON 2022)
source.figure: Fig. 2 (p.3): preamplifier / comparator core, inverters + RS latch, decision circuit, output buffer

clock_frequency_Hz.provenance: paper: Fig. 3 caption (f_samp = 1 GHz), Table 3/5 (1 GHz)

clock_edge_time_s.provenance: benchmark_default_unreviewed: paper gives no edge time; Fig. 3 clock edges are steep on a 1.5 ns axis (about 10-20 ps)

input_common_mode_V.provenance: paper: Fig. 3 caption and Table 3 (Vcm = 0.9 V typical); the delay points set their own Vcm

output_load_F.provenance: benchmark_default_unreviewed: paper gives no load capacitance (only symbolic node caps Cx, Cy, Cp, Cq in Table 1); 5 fF on OUT as in the other comparator tasks
